questions.prompt: You draw a messages line between two seats. What can each agent now do to the other?

choices.text: List and send mail, prompt it, wait for it, and read its terminal
choices.why: A messages line grants exactly those five: msg.list, msg.send, msg.prompt, seat.wait and terminal.read.

choices.text: Edit the other seat's files and settings
choices.why: A line grants messaging and observation only; nothing in it reaches another seat's files or settings.

choices.text: Nothing until the operator approves each message
choices.why: There is no per-message approval: the line itself is the grant.

questions.prompt: An agent mails a seat it has no line to, outside its region. What happens?

choices.text: The call is refused: no edge and not region co-members
choices.why: Without a line or a shared region the target is not visible to the caller, and the CLI says so.

choices.text: The mail waits until the operator draws a line
choices.why: Nothing is queued: the refusal is immediate and names why.

choices.text: It is delivered, since both seats are on the same canvas
choices.why: Being on one canvas grants nothing; reach comes from lines and regions.

questions.prompt: You are typing a draft into a seat's terminal when mail for it arrives. What does Junto do?

choices.text: Holds the mail until the input is free, then types it in
choices.why: Mail is typed only into a composer the operator is not using, and held otherwise.

choices.text: Types it after your draft, so both go together
choices.why: Junto never types over or after your draft; it waits for the input to be free.

choices.text: Drops the mail so your draft is not disturbed
choices.why: Held mail is delivered later, not dropped.

questions.prompt: A seat ran `junto blocked`. You answer it from the feed with a quick reply. How does the agent hear it?

choices.text: The answer is typed into its terminal as operator mail
choices.why: Answering types the response into the seat as operator mail, then records the signal answered.

choices.text: It has to poll for the answer itself
choices.why: A reply is typed in as mail. Only a silent answer waits for the agent to read it with `junto signal list`.

choices.text: It is not told; the signal just closes
choices.why: That is what dismissing does. A reply is delivered.
